title: In situ formed amorphous carbon-coated LiMn2O4 cathode with long-term stability for lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27223-27231
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02942F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wangqiong Xu, Xianrong Li, Xueqing Kang, Lijuan Chen, Baiyan Guo, Qiling Li, Kun Xu, Yiming Cao, Zhe Li, Yongsheng Liu
This study presents an amorphous carbon layer coated on the surface of LiMn2O4, which serves as a structural stabilization agent to enhance the electrochemical performance of LiMn2O4.
